XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Steering

  • Component: Steering box

  • Fault: The vehicle exhibits stiff power steering; at the same time, the power steering fault (red), tyre fault and ESP warning lights come on.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • U0428 (Data reception fault – Steering position sensor module)
    • B1168 (Fault – Steering angle)
    • C1146 (Fault – Tyre pressure)
  • Cause: Faulty steering box

• Intervention: Check the condition and correct functioning of the steering box; replace if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the defective component did not show any visual abnormalities and, after replacement, it was necessary to adjust the "steering angle" using diagnostic equipment to definitively resolve the anomaly.
    The component in question is located centrally between the engine and the passenger compartment and is accessible from the underside of the engine.
